old_caption:
The video captures a vibrant nighttime scene at what appears to be an outdoor concert or event. The focal point is a large, modern building illuminated by dynamic green laser lights. The building's facade is bathed in various colors, including blue and purple, with beams of green lasers projecting outward, creating a mesmerizing visual effect. The lasers vary in intensity and direction, sometimes converging into bright spots and other times spreading out in wide arcs.

In the foreground, silhouettes of numerous attendees are visible, their heads and shoulders forming a dense crowd. Some individuals are holding up their phones, likely capturing the spectacle. The crowd remains mostly stationary, suggesting they are focused on the performance. The camera moves throughout, including pans and tilts, allowing viewers to absorb the spectacle of the illuminated building and the lively crowd.
original_wisa_caption:
The video captures a vibrant nighttime scene at what appears to be an outdoor concert or event. The focal point is a large, modern building illuminated by dynamic laser lights. The building's facade is bathed in a striking blue light, with vertical lines of green and white lasers projecting outward, creating a mesmerizing visual effect. The lasers vary in intensity and direction, sometimes converging into bright spots and other times spreading out in wide arcs.

In the foreground, silhouettes of numerous attendees are visible, their heads and shoulders forming a dense crowd. Some individuals are holding up their phones, likely capturing the spectacle. The crowd remains mostly stationary, suggesting they are focused on the performance. The atmosphere is electric, with the interplay of light and shadow adding to the sense of excitement and wonder. The camera remains steady throughout, allowing viewers to fully absorb the spectacle of the illuminated building and the lively crowd.
caption: The video captures a night-time outdoor light show projected onto a modern building with a central cylindrical tower flanked by two flat rectangular wings. Its facade is floodlit in saturated color while a silhouetted crowd stands in the foreground and one figure works a console at the right edge. Bright green laser beams pour from a glowing point at the base-center, spreading outward in a dense radial fan. This fan collapses into near darkness, then narrow diagonal and vertical beams reappear. The beams then shift into side-only fans while the floodlight turns from blue to magenta. A dense radial fan returns around the magenta tower before the color drifts back toward blue. The fan fades to darkness again, leaving only the lit building and a few faint top beams. A vertical center beam and crossing diagonals emerge, then vanish into another dark interval. Side-only beams appear again, the crowd and console figure remaining unmoved.

Write a corrected WISA-style training caption for this exact video clip.
This clip is a temporally cropped excerpt, with arbitrary start and end boundaries. It is NOT
necessarily a complete action and it is NOT a loop. Describe the visible portion of a process
without inventing how it began or how it ultimately ends. A process may already be happening
on the first frame and still be happening after the last. Do not force the endpoints to match,
infer a physical error from their mismatch, or manufacture continuity across a visible edit.
Use the chronological video as primary evidence. The independent visual notes are fallible aids,
not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.
You receive the original WISA caption's stylistic profile, without its possibly wrong facts.
Retain its English narrative voice, viewpoint, paragraph structure and level of visual detail.
Aim for 85-115% of the original WISA word count,
and retain supported scene details while clearly describing the main visible process. Do not
replace it with a short keyword prompt, physics explanation, checklist or a generic summary.
Correct wrong subjects, actions, directions, contacts, temporal ordering and completion claims.
Distinguish an already ongoing process from a new event actually visible within this excerpt.
Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
Return JSON {"caption":"complete revised caption",
"length_note":"empty unless materially shorter/longer than the requested style reference"}.
